# Email polisher

Use this skill when the user shares a draft email and wants it improved.

## Rules
- Keep the sender's meaning and every fact; never add new claims.
- Prefer short sentences and plain words.
- Remove filler openers such as "I hope this email finds you well".
- End with one clear next step for the reader.

## Output
Return only the rewritten email, ready to paste.
